jobs.description: Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report. Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off. You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
